gen-dafont-visitor-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans draws smooth, single-stroke letters with curve ends held apart. Visitor brings a nostalgic, digital punch with towering lowercase and gaping e mouths, while the moderate-height body underneath lets the page settle down.
gen-dafont-woodgod-space-grotesk: Reading like a drafting pen at work, the body stays constant and geometric while Woodgod swaggers above it. Space Grotesk keeps its open counters breathing across many lines, so paragraphs move along without clogging.
gen-eater-fs-chillax: Dark and snarling, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its ascenders short. And Chillax lays down a relaxed, spaghetti-soft line with unfinished loops, so extended reading feels loose and unhurried.
gen-eater-fs-plein: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters wide with short ascenders. Plein feels reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter, so long reading goes down smoothly.
gen-eater-fs-roundo: Roundo moves along in a geometric, wire-bent line, its n arch matching its stem. But Eater has wide gaps and sturdy thin lines, a dark bite the body never tries for.
gen-eater-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve, quietly dependable beside Eater. Across a full page, it reads clean, steady and undemanding.
gen-eater-gf-aclonica: Eater spaces its letters wide apart, dark and aggressive. Aclonica stretches out a widely spaced line with deep lowercase midsections, so extended reading moves along at an unhurried pace.
gen-eater-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans reads clean and approachable, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Eater is best at dark, aggressive impact in a heading, while Alumni Sans is best at quiet, understated text.
gen-eater-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Dark and snarling, Eater spreads wide gaps between its letters. Eater is built for loud headings, while Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs tight word texture with oversized lowercase beside small capitals.
gen-eater-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs rounded, open forms into a dense huddle that fills the line like capitals, a modern foil to Eater. Anaheim brings approachable density that makes Eater's dark aggression stand out.
